pages.text: A miner seals side fluid inlets and underground gaps at least 2×2 wide and tall. Walls line the outside of the work chunk, preserving its two-block-wide stairs. Ordinary open air above the entrance is left open.

Each wall cell uses one cobblestone from its own bag and one stamina. Missing cobblestone pauses work; transport supplies up to one stack. Walls need no bucket, but remaining fluid removal still does.

Missing stair treads use supported repair materials such as cobblestone, stone, dirt, or deepslate. Placement respects protected blocks and entities. An unreachable repair pauses without spending material.
